verdict.rationale: x402 is described as an open, vendor-neutral protocol now governed by the Linux Foundation, and sellers add payment logic directly to their own servers with one line of code (self-hosted resource server) — but the core settlement/verification component (the Facilitator) is explicitly documented as Coinbase's hosted CDP service, with no evidence of a self-hostable Facilitator implementation or instructions to run one independently. missing for 10: documented self-hosted Facilitator/verification service, open-source repo for running the full stack independently of CDP, evidence of third-party self-hosted facilitators in production.
